chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-'Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of them (peace be upon both of them)
He was asked about a slave who accused his wife (of adultery), and he said: 'They perform la'n (mutual cursing) just as the free men perform la'n.'
ai.seo_question: What is the procedure for a slave to accuse his wife of adultery according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies that the *li'an* procedure for a slave is identical to that of a free man, emphasizing the legal parity between the two in this specific judicial context. It highlights the Imam's application of the general rule from Surah An-Nur to the specific status of slaves, ensuring consistency in marital dispute resolution within Shia jurisprudence. The ruling underscores that the ritual of mutual cursing to establish or deny paternity applies uniformly regardless of the husband's social status.
